name: domain-experts
description: Toolkit for building, evaluating, evolving, and contributing domain expert agents in Claude Code. Four skills (domain-creator, domain-eval, domain-capture, domain-contribute) plus Nala — a venture-building reference agent built using the toolkit. v0.4 adds a PRD-first path to domain-creator: point it at docs/prd.md and it proposes identity, domain, primary user, categories, reference implementation, and comparable peers — with strict domain-widening discipline so the agent is built around the WIDER category, never the specific product the PRD describes. Collapses the 10-turn interview to ~3 turns for PRD-bearing ventures.
